item.title: Rubbish everywhere, 30th July
item.description:
This person dumped their whole garage contents out and fly tipped. In the middle of the day with no care. When I got back from the shop in the evening when it was dark, rubbish all still there, I fell over while carrying shopping bags as some of the rubbish was now in the middle of the walkway, I fell over on some plastic that had fallen off something. This area is known for fly tipping. I think cameras should be installed to catch people quite easily. It’s a joke.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Hopwood Road, Walworth, Greater London
